items.title: Theodore Purnell Interview, 1972-06-16
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] How long, you toured with Mamie Smith? Huh? You traveled with Mamie Smith? Yes.

ctx.x: Yeah man. I've been all over the country. Oh yeah? Where? I've been to New York, I went to Chicago, I went to St. Louis, I went to Kentucky, I went to Kentucky, I went to, I can't tell you where I ain't been man. I've been all over this country man. Who did you travel with?
What band? Arthur P. Sean, Mamie Smith, or Sam Morgan.

Man I don't know, I've been to the place till I go there, till I see the place. Yeah. Then I know I was there. You can't remember all the times you're in. No man, I've been that way. Must have been on a lot of things. Oh yeah man. You can't remember all the times you're in. No man, I've been that way. Must have been on a lot of things. Oh yeah man. You can't remember them all. No I was in. Did you ever play on any boats? On a cabin? No. No. No. I was in.
